text.description_html:
5" x 4 1/2" x Square Corners Heavy Duty Commercial Door Hinge

Extra heavy duty (0.190" thick) stainless steel commercial door hinge with 4 ball bearings and Non-Removable Pin. Conforms to ANSI A5111

Fitted with a high grade, Non-Removable, rust resistant, stainless steel pin for security. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications for the Don-Jo HWBB95045-630 Stainless Steel Hinge:

  • Height: 5"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.190" (Extra Heavy Duty)
  • 4 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Non-Removable Hinge Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Stainless Steel Hinge Pin
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A5111
  • Weight Capacity: 300 lbs.
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo HWBB95045-630 Dimensions (PDF)

Package with Stainless Steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with heavy metal or wood doors.

*Sold Individually
